messages.content: You are handing a case over to the next analyst, who will make the decision. For every candidate claim, record whether the original records establish it (supported), establish its negation (contradicted), or do neither (unresolved). Attach exact source identifiers of decisive records, or an empty list if none settle it. Copy the preceding analyst's numeric estimates of claim truth as confidence values. Preserve unresolved status absent new independent evidence. Use the note to summarize the relevant record contents and preserve source identifiers for anything mentioned. Keep the note under 100 words.
